prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: deployable portfolio website concept screenshot
Primary request: Create a polished desktop website mockup for a game developer portfolio with a meaningful chatbot. This is concept 5 of 5 and should be a clean narrative product page rather than a dashboard.
Scene/backdrop: full-browser screenshot of a calm, highly readable portfolio site that feels like a product case-study page with an embedded conversational guide
Subject: a narrative layout with a strong opening statement about the developer, one or two featured games, role and strengths sections, technology blocks, and a chatbot entry point integrated as part of the reading flow. The assistant appears as contextual prompts or an expandable panel that helps visitors ask about experience, project decisions, and best-fit skills.
Style/medium: high-fidelity editorial web design, restrained and practical, premium but buildable
Composition/framing: wide desktop page with clear reading path from intro to games to strengths to tech to Q&A; more whitespace and fewer cards than previous concepts
Lighting/mood: warm, thoughtful, trustworthy
Color palette: parchment white, deep navy, olive accents, muted rust highlights
Materials/textures: subtle gradients, crisp typography, soft dividers, minimal shadows
Text (verbatim): "Hong Jinho", "Featured Games", "Strengths", "Technology", "Ask About My Work"
Constraints: make it obviously different from dashboard and shelf concepts; still include games, developer profile, technology, and chatbot; no watermark
Avoid: busy grids, loud neon, terminal styling, ecommerce metaphors, repeated layout patterns from the other four
summary: Concept 05 is the most editorial of the set, using a quiet narrative reading path and subtle chatbot entry points to explain the developer without distracting from the featured work.
generation_notes: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool in default mode. Chosen to balance the more interaction-heavy options with a calmer product-page direction that still preserves chatbot utility.
